t: Said while everyone around him was digging
a: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ عَيْشَ إِلاَّ عَيْشُ الآخِرَة، فَأَصْلِحِ الأَنْصَارَ وَالْمُهَاجِرَة
p: Allāhumma lā ʿaysha illā ʿayshu-l-ākhirah, fa-aṣliḥi-l-anṣāra wa-l-muhājirah.
m: O Allah, there is no life except the life of the Hereafter, so set right the Anṣār and the Muhājirūn.
